title: Shopify turns on agentic checkout in ChatGPT by default
summary: Shopify renamed Direct checkout to agentic checkout across its AI channels and opened it to ChatGPT. It is switched on by default for eligible US stores that let Shopify manage their channels; merchants who do not want it must opt out, and there are no fees beyond standard processing.
whyItMatters: Opt-out defaults, not opt-in pilots, are how agent shopping reaches millions of merchants at once.
